preconditions.description: The length of the mask m is between 1 and 100,000.
The length of the mask m is exactly n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in ['#', '_'] for c in m)
preconditions.description: The mask m consists only of the characters '#' and '_'.

postconditions.description: If there is no profile with the mask m, output -1. Otherwise, output the number of integers in the profile p' and the integers themselves.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (all(0 < p[i] <= n for i in range(output[0])))
postconditions.description: If there is a profile with the mask m, the integers in the profile p' are positive and do not exceed n.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (all(m[sum(p[:i+1])-p[i]:sum(p[:i+1])] == '#'*p[i] for i in range(output[0])))
postconditions.description: If there is a profile with the mask m, the profile p' satisfies the mask m.
